description: Source code for a WolfSSL-based cryptographic utility that generates RSA/ECC keys and self-signed certificates, including functions for key generation, certificate creation, and file writing.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a specified file or standard error, with optional file permissions and fsync.

methods.name: write_key
methods.description: Converts an ECC or RSA key to DER format, optionally encodes to PEM, and writes to a file.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Generates an ECC or RSA key pair based on specified parameters.

methods.name: selfsigned
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate with specified parameters, including key type, validity, and subject attributes.

methods.name: dokey
methods.description: Generates a key pair (ECC or RSA) with optional parameters and writes it to a file.
